tender_overview.title: Design, Supply, and Installation of Plant
tender_overview.bid_system: Single Stage Two-Envelope Bidding Process with e-Procurement

scope_of_work.category: GIS Data Collection and Asset Management
scope_of_work.details: Collection of attributes (Data Model) for assets, GPS coordinates mapping, physical marking procedure for assets and consumers, data verification through Executive Engineer and circle SE, updating GIS asset information for completion certificate issuance using GEO URJA mobile app

Design, manufacture, procurement, quality assurance, construction, installation, civil works, pre-commissioning and delivery of Plant, installation, completion and commissioning of facilities including supervision, engineering services, labor, materials, equipment, spare parts, transportation and storage
Providing engineering data and drawings for review, approval and records, preparation of project completion report/closure proposal, handing over works to employer for commercial services
Supply, testing, packing, transportation and insurance from manufacturer's work to site, receipt, storage, insurance, preservation and conservation of equipment at site
Fabrication, pre-assembly, erection, testing and putting into satisfactory operation of all equipment/materials including successful commissioning, warranty period services

Supply of raw materials including steel, zinc for galvanizing, reinforcement steel, cement for foundation, coke for earthing, bolts, nuts, washers, danger plates, phase plates, number plates for substations and structures - all steel structures except STPs to be hot dip galvanized

Energy Efficiency Level-1 transformers as per IS 1180 (Part-1):2014 and amendments, manufactured by authorized licensee with BIS certification standard mark, mandatory engraving of 'Developed under SI' on transformers

33 KV & 11 KV lines, 33/11 KV substations, distribution transformer substations, LT lines, service lines including items not specifically mentioned but required for successful installation, testing, commissioning and performance

Field survey for location of poles, distribution transformers, proposed route of 33 KV/11KV/LT lines, 33/11 KV substation locations, feeder wise Bill of Quantity (BOQ) preparation, mapping of existing electrical infrastructure

Architectural and civil designs for control room, foundation for equipment, transformer, isolators, VCB requiring approval from Employer's Engineer-in-charge, cement concreting for support foundations

PSC poles (8 meter long/200 KG), M.S. Beams (9m/11m/13m variants), steel tubular poles, wide parallel beams with jointing plates for different terrain requirements including rural, urban, forest and hilly areas
Comprehensive Quality Assurance mechanism (QAM) and Inspection Plan, pre-commissioning test checklist for 11 kV MVCC, earth resistance and insulation resistance testing, joint record maintenance
Signboards for major infrastructure showing work details, commissioning date, estimated cost, scheme information, mandatory engraving on poles, transformers, cables, energy meters
Return of replaced old materials to area stores, proper bundling and tagging of old PVC wire with weight indication

technical.similar_works_definition: Erecting, testing and commissioning of (11 KV & above voltage class) cabelling works either turnkey or partial turnkey in any under Public electrical utility of Central or State Govt. / Government Sector / Power Utility (Government or Private) / Power sector PSUs & Power Sector CPSUs / Any Private or Government power generating or transmitting company/private Developer

options.requirement: Experience in similar work under single contract, costing not less than Rs. 133.31 Crore (70% of estimated amount)
Experience in similar works under two contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 76.18 Crore (40% of estimated amount each)
Experience in similar works under three contracts, each costing not less than Rs. 57.13 Crore (30% of estimated amount each)

financial.requirement: Must be positive for each of the last three Financial Years (paid up capital + free reserves - accumulated losses - intangible assets)
Best three years out of last five financial years should not be less than Rs. 5713.52 Lakhs (30% of estimated cost)
Not less than Rs. 1904.50 Lakhs (10% of estimated cost) - liquid assets and/or evidence of access to fund-based credit facilities

special_requirements: Volume and quality of concreting must be as per specifications - non-compliance requires dismantling and redoing at contractor's cost
Performance Security valid till 180 days beyond Defect Liability Period
Extended defect liability period for specific components as specified in SCC
Latent defects warranty period as specified in SCC after Defect Liability Period
Third party inspection at NABL accredited lab for major materials
